Hi Kenji / Priyanka — great to meet you both.

Thanks for the details. Short answers first: yes, we can do a demo that covers multi-region routing and graceful fallbacks. I pulled a few proposed slots and included them as an attachment (CSV) and on Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/apac-demo.

Important note on timezones (to avoid the next-day confusion):
- Sydney (AEDT) is UTC+11 in December (DST in effect).
- Singapore (SGT) is UTC+8; Tokyo (JST) is UTC+9.

To avoid midnight crossovers for Sydney participants, I recommend these alternatives (both show local times + UTC):
Option 1 (earlier local): Tue Dec 8, 13:30–14:15 SGT / 14:30–15:15 JST / 15:30–16:15 AEDT (UTC+8: 05:30–06:15Z)
Option 2 (same-window, but shift earlier): Tue Dec 8, 11:00–11:45 SGT / 12:00–12:45 JST / 13:00–13:45 AEDT (UTC+8: 03:00–03:45Z)

I attached proposed_slots.csv with these options. If we pick Option 1, it keeps Sydney comfortably before 17:00 AEDT; Option 2 gives a bigger buffer.

Operational ask: when sending the calendar invite, please put both the local time and UTC in the description (e.g., "14:30 JST / 13:30 SGT / 05:30 UTC") — Gmail sometimes shows the date in the recipient's local timezone which causes the "next-day" perception.

Attachment: [proposed_slots.csv (CSV, 1.7KB)]

Best,
Priya Natarajan
